About — SOHO Fit

Private,personal,proven.

SOHO Fit is a private personal training company based in Tampa. For over a decade we’ve helped clients lose weight, tone, gain muscle or simply get healthier, in private studios built for one-on-one coaching.

Our clients range from complete beginners and busy professionals to parents, athletes and seniors. Beyond the studios, we train in homes, offices and residential communities across Tampa.

We sell training and nothing else. You’ll never be asked to buy anything extra, and we don’t accept money for referrals.

Private

No crowds, no waiting for equipment, no one watching.

Personal

A program built around your goals, body and calendar.

Measured

InBody scans and benchmarks, tracked in your app.

Recognized

Voted Best of South Tampa, South Tampa Magazine · 2023, 2024 & 2025.

FAQ

What makes Soho Fit different from a traditional gym in Tampa?

Soho Fit is a private personal training studio built entirely around individualized coaching and results. There are no crowded workout floors, fighting for equipment, or trying to figure out what to do on your own. Every workout at Soho Fit is one-on-one with a dedicated expert personal trainer and customized around your goals, fitness level, abilities, and progress. Our clients range from complete beginners and busy professionals, moms and dads to athletes, seniors, and people of all ages and fitness levels simply looking to become stronger, healthier, and more confident. With an experienced team of personal trainers, private studios, flexible scheduling, and personalized programming, we provide the structure, accountability, and expertise that traditional gyms simply do not. At Soho Fit, you’re not paying for access to a gym — you’re investing in a personal trainer and a program built around you, your goals and your lifestyle.

Does Soho Fit create a fitness program based on my individual goals?

Yes. Every Soho Fit personal training program is built around the individual client’s goals, fitness level, experience, lifestyle, and needs. Your trainer will take the time to understand your goals, fitness level, experience, lifestyle, and any limitations or concerns before developing a personalized training plan. Whether your goal is to lose weight, build strength, improve mobility, increase muscle, enhance athletic performance, or simply feel and move better, your workouts are designed specifically for what you want to accomplish. As you progress, your trainer continually adjusts your program based on your results, increasing abilities, and changing goals. There’s no one-size-fits-all training at Soho Fit — your goals determine your program.

How does Soho Fit track personal fitness progress?

At Soho Fit, we believe progress should be measured, not guessed. Your personal trainer tracks your progress throughout your fitness journey using a combination of strength and performance benchmarks, body measurements, InBody body composition scans, mobility and movement assessments, and progress toward your individual goals. Your trainer also monitors how you’re performing during each session and continually adjusts your workouts as you become stronger, fitter, and more capable. Because progress looks different for everyone, we focus on the measurements that matter most to your goals — whether that’s losing body fat, gaining muscle, increasing strength, improving mobility, enhancing athletic performance, or simply feeling and moving better. Your program evolves as you do, so you’re always working toward the next level of progress.

Can I choose a personal trainer who fits my personality and goals?

Yes. Soho Fit helps match clients with a personal trainer whose experience, coaching style, availability, and personality fit their goals and preferences. Our team of personal trainers brings a wide range of backgrounds, personalities, specialties, and training styles. We’ll help match you with a trainer based on your goals, experience level, schedule, preferred coaching style, and personality. Whether you’re looking for someone highly motivating and energetic, patient and encouraging, focused on strength and performance, or experienced in areas such as weight loss, mobility, senior fitness, youth training, women’s fitness, or athletic performance, we’ll work to find the right fit for you. And if you ever feel another trainer may be a better match, just let us know. Our priority is making sure you have a trainer you enjoy working with and who can help you achieve your goals.

Does Soho Fit offer both private and small group personal training?

While Soho Fit specializes in private, one-on-one personal training, we also offer Partner Training for clients who want to work out with a friend, spouse, family member, or workout partner. Partner Training still provides the personalized approach Soho Fit is known for. Your trainer will structure and modify the session to account for each participant’s individual fitness level, abilities, and goals, so you can train together without sacrificing personalized coaching. Whether you prefer the individual attention of one-on-one training or enjoy having someone alongside you, Soho Fit gives you the flexibility to choose the training experience that works best for you.

What fitness goals can Soho Fit personal training support?

Soho Fit personal training can support virtually any fitness goal, with every program customized to the individual. Our trainers work with clients of all ages and fitness levels on goals including weight loss, building strength and muscle, body recomposition, improving mobility and flexibility, increasing endurance, enhancing athletic performance, improving balance and stability, healthy aging, and simply feeling better and more confident in everyday life. We also work with clients who have more specific goals, such as youth athletic development, prenatal and postpartum fitness, returning to exercise after time away, or building strength and maintaining muscle while or after using GLP-1 medications. You don’t need to arrive at Soho Fit with a specific fitness level or even a perfectly defined goal. Tell us what you want to accomplish, and we’ll build a personalized plan to help you get there and then we’ll evolve your fitness routine with you as you progress in your fitness journey.

Is Soho Fit suitable for busy professionals in South Tampa?

Yes. Soho Fit is designed for busy South Tampa professionals, business owners, parents, and executives who want personalized fitness coaching without spending hours at a traditional gym. We offer 30, 45, and 60-minute personal training sessions, flexible scheduling, and two convenient South Tampa locations. Our sessions can start as early as 5 a.m. and as late as 8 p.m. and we also train on Saturdays. Because every session is one-on-one with a personal trainer, you can arrive, get straight to work, and make the most of the time you have available. Your trainer handles the planning, programming, and progression, so there’s no need to figure out what workout to do or waste time wandering around a gym. For busy South Tampa professionals, Soho Fit provides an efficient, personalized, and accountable way to make fitness a consistent part of your schedule.

Where is Soho Fit located in South Tampa?

Soho Fit has two private personal training studios in South Tampa, with locations in Hyde Park / SoHo and Westshore. Our Hyde Park / SoHo studio is located at Soho Fit, 715 S. Howard Ave., Suite #100 and #130, Tampa, FL 33606, right next to Starbucks in the heart of SoHo. Our Westshore studio is located at Soho Fit, 3431 S. Westshore Blvd., Tampa, FL 33629, near the intersection of Westshore Boulevard and El Prado. Both locations provide the same private, personalized Soho Fit experience, with one-on-one personal training, professional trainers, and programs customized around your individual goals. For clients who prefer to train outside of our studios, Soho Fit also offers in-home personal training throughout the Tampa area, including training at your home or community gym.

Who is Soho Fit?

Soho Fit is a private personal training company based in Tampa, Florida, specializing in one-on-one personal training and individualized fitness programs. Soho Fit operates South Tampa personal training studios in Hyde Park / SoHo and Westshore and also provides in-home, corporate, residential-community, and other customized fitness services throughout the Tampa area.

Where can I find private personal training in South Tampa?

Soho Fit provides private one-on-one personal training in South Tampa at studios in Hyde Park / Soho and Westshore. Every session is led by a dedicated personal trainer and built around your goals, fitness level, schedule, and progress.

How do I choose the right personal trainer in Tampa?

Look for a personal trainer whose experience, coaching style, availability, and specialties align with your goals. At Soho Fit, we help match clients with a trainer based on factors such as fitness goals, experience level, schedule, preferred coaching style, and personality, and we can help you change trainers if your needs evolve.

Does Soho Fit offer personal training near Hyde Park, SoHo, and Westshore Tampa?

Yes. Soho Fit has South Tampa personal training studios in Hyde Park / SoHo at 715 S. Howard Ave. and in Westshore at 3431 S. Westshore Blvd. Clients can choose the location that best fits their home, work, and daily routine.
